name: Alert and chase when a new lead is not contacted fast
summary: Alerts the owner the moment a new lead lands, queues one first text for approval if nobody has replied in time, and escalates to a senior person when a lead is still uncontacted. Crons read and draft internal tasks; a person approves every text to a lead.

all | other-tool.evidence: 4 of the 6 calls read for this mining pass named a tool (AI agent, GoHighLevel, AI assistant); typical order first contact, then qualify and book

all | by-hand-or-unstated.evidence: 1 of 6 calls: the owner texts website form inquiries by hand; typical order first contact, then an automated chase

lead-arrives.covered_by: intake (reads new opportunities in the new-lead stage)

instant-alert.covered_by: intake (one internal task to the owner per new lead)

first-contact.covered_by: chase (queues one SMS for approval once the wait is set)

chase-message.covered_by: not yet: a second message is a gap, see gaps

escalate-overdue.covered_by: escalate (one internal task to the senior person)

response-check.covered_by: not yet: the GoHighLevel docs read do not give a time-to-first-contact report

assign-owner.covered_by: not yet: the owner is a fixed setting, not round-robin

qualify-book.covered_by: not covered: judgment on the call

record-keeping.covered_by: the tasks and the lead store; no CRM note is written

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: New open leads in the new-lead stage: one internal alert task to the owner each.

crons.name: chase
crons.summary: Leads still uncontacted after the set wait: queue one first text for approval.

crons.name: escalate
crons.summary: Leads still uncontacted after the escalation time: one internal task to the senior person.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads and internal tasks for staff. Nothing a customer receives is a draft operation. The first text to a lead is live and waits for a person.

gohighlevel.covers: new leads, the owner alert, the first text, the escalation, and checks for a reply or a handled lead

gaps: HubSpot: lead, alert and record-keeping steps are marked yes, but no task object is mapped (the pages read do not cover tasks) and the lead operation ids are malformed. No adapter built.
Pipedrive: new leads can be read (GET /leads), but the note and task write bodies are not in the spec copy read, so no alert can be confirmed. No adapter built.

GoHighLevel send body: the official spec marks subType and status as required on Send a new message, and the values this build sends (SMS, pending) are not confirmed. The first live send needs a sandbox run before go-live.
GoHighLevel push alerts to the owner's phone are not a mapped operation. The alert is an internal task, which the owner sees in the app.
Round-robin routing of a new lead to a free person is not shown in the pages read. The owner is a fixed setting.
A phone call that leaves no message is not visible to the workflow. A lead the owner calls and moves out of the new-lead stage is handled; a call that does not move the stage is not.
Time-to-first-contact reporting and retry-until-answered sequences are not shown in the pages read.
Only the first page of messages is checked for an outbound message (20 messages).
Only the SMS channel is built. Email first contact is not built.
Qualification and booking on the first call are judgment steps for the team, not automated here.

evidence.calls: 33 calls tagged for this workflow in the worklist; 6 read for the variants pass, 5 described the process
evidence.platforms: the mining platform file maps GoHighLevel (yes on lead-arrives, first-contact, chase-message and record-keeping), HubSpot and Pipedrive; only GoHighLevel has confirmed fields for every operation built
